rationale: The change introduces an explicit configurable braking-zone definition in place of the previously unspecified dangerous-zone boundary. The baseline ties H1-ORR3 to the dangerous-zone definition via H1-A3/H1-RC3, and its rationale explicitly says the dangerous-zone boundary is tbd. Because the distance/spatial-information requirement and dangerous-zone definition have changed, the existing derivational basis for the CRD H1-CRD3 is no longer applicable, while the evaluation target and overall phenomenon of interest remain the same. Therefore derivation must resume at RR3 rather than revalidating individual ORRs.
